name: bobs-books-api
description: Two read-only tools for Bob's Used Books

toolOverrides.name: ListBooks
toolOverrides.description: List a page of inventory: title, author, book type, condition, genre, price, and quantity. Use this to find available books. Omit cursor for the first page; use the returned cursor for another page.

toolOverrides.name: GetBook
toolOverrides.description: Get a book by its id, including format, condition, price, and availability. Use a book identifier returned by ListBooks.
